title: Preserve result cardinality and release streams when returning Optional
summary: The new Optional accessors agreed for collections, iterators, and streams. The unsized two-row stream stopped at its second equal reference and closed once, including on the exception path.

change.description: DataAccessUtils adds optionalResult overloads for Collection, Iterator and Stream and singleResult overloads for Iterator and Stream. Eleven submitted commits landed as one revision.

notes: Singleton results retained object identity. The existing collection method continued to count equal rows separately.
